construction.terrain: Connected indexed terrain surface over a soil substrate with a narrow rear stream and widening foreground pool; narrow terrain berms support the descending right route.
construction.hall: Roof and pagoda anchors retained. The lower story is shortened to meet a raised entrance floor. Low rubble courses and a capped footing meet the planted hillside.
construction.route: Closed arched bed and jointed stone deck, timber edge beams and rails, twelve main stair treads, six connector treads, fourteen descending right approach treads. Landing bearing beams and uniformly scaled rubble courses support the over-bank span.
construction.pine: Existing articulated bark skeletons, forked branchlets and needle fascicles retained; dense upward needle shoots overlap in flattened irregular crown lobes. No opaque foliage hulls.
construction.garden: Separate folded leaves and supporting twigs, uniformly scaled scan stones, flowers, notched lily pads, separate open lotus petals and narrow curved water sheets. Route and building exclusions keep major paths clear.
construction.bell: Eighteen curved cast-bronze wall panels with ninety actual through-holes, closed cast rim/crown, relief ribs, thirteen alternating chain links and a timber ceiling bearing. Existing body anchor is retained.
construction.overheadEave: The retained rafter corner is completed with a closed hip roof, long bearing members, transverse beams and four ground-founded posts outside the fixed reference side edges. Hidden support locations and dimensions remain authored hypotheses, not engineering certification.
